items.headline: J-Hope and Nigo remix the Nike Air Force 1
items.caption: BTS's sneakerhead J-Hope teams up with streetwear legend Nigo on his first sneaker collab.
body: J-Hope, the BTS member known as the band's sneakerhead, made his first-ever sneaker collaboration with Nigo and Nike.
The pair put their own spin on the classic Air Force 1.
How to wear it: let the shoe be the loud part, with plain jeans and a simple tee.

items.headline: A wildlife bridge cut animal-car crashes by 91%
items.caption: North America's largest wildlife overpass is working, just 10 months after opening.
body: Just 10 months after opening, the largest wildlife overpass in North America has cut crashes between animals and vehicles by 91%.
Animals now cross over the road instead of through the traffic.

items.headline: The 'Hulk Tee' is the unlikely look of the season
items.caption: Worn-in tees that look stretched to breaking point, as seen on Jeremy Allen White and Austin Butler.
body: The 'Hulk Tee' is a washed, worn-in T-shirt that looks stretched tight at the arms and gives way at the neck.
Jeremy Allen White and Austin Butler are both fans.
How to wear it: keep the rest simple, like White's cap, slacks and white Nike Cortez.

items.headline: Vets give a rare hornbill a 3D-printed beak
items.caption: A world first: wildlife vets fitted a rare hornbill with a new beak.
body: Wildlife vets fitted a rare hornbill with a 3D-printed beak, in what they call a world first.
They say it had never been possible before.

items.headline: GQ's 50 pieces for the perfect cold-weather wardrobe
items.caption: The essentials every man needs from September to March, built to mix and match.
body: GQ picked the 50 pieces of clothing every man needs for autumn and winter.
Staples like jeans, button-front shirts and hoodies return, with new layers added for the colder months.
How to use it: start with the basics you already own, then add one good coat and one great knit.

items.headline: New York's pedestrian deaths hit a 100-year low
items.caption: Fewer people are dying while walking in New York City than in over a century.
body: Pedestrian deaths in New York City have fallen to their lowest level in more than 100 years.

items.headline: Valentino's new Stud Up sneaker revives a classic
items.caption: Alessandro Michele's hand-finished sneaker borrows Valentino's famous Rockstud.
body: Valentino's Alessandro Michele introduced the hand-finished Valentino Garavani Stud Up sneaker.
It comes from his Fall/Winter 2026-27 'Interferenze' collection and draws on the brand's Rockstud archive.
It is already in Valentino boutiques and on valentino.com.

items.headline: Sudan lifts vaccination to 71% despite civil war
items.caption: In a single year, and in the middle of a war, Sudan raised its vaccination coverage to 71%.
body: Sudan raised its vaccination coverage to 71% in a single year.
It did this despite an ongoing civil war.

items.headline: This week's best sneakers: SZA's Vans to MM6 Salomons
items.caption: Highsnobiety's seven best sneakers of the week, from a Vans mule to a chunky Pharrell adidas.
body: Highsnobiety picked the seven best sneakers out this week.
They include SZA's Vans Old Skool Mule, MM6 Maison Margiela's Salomon trail shoe, an OTTO 958 x ASICS pair and a chunky Pharrell Williams adidas.
How to wear it: trail-style sneakers like the Salomons look sharp with straight trousers, not just hiking gear.

items.headline: Dress like a country gent this winter
items.caption: Chunky knits, sturdy boots and estate-ready layers from Mr Porter, picked by Highsnobiety.
body: Highsnobiety and Mr Porter put together the winter essentials for a 'countryside-core' look.
Think chunky knit sweaters and sturdy boots, made for long walks and pub lunches.
How to wear it: one thick knit and good boots do most of the work, even in the city.

items.headline: The perfect old-school Oxford shirt still exists
items.caption: J.Press still makes its button-down Oxford with the retro details Ivy-style fans love.
body: GQ says it is hard to find a button-down Oxford shirt made with the old details Ivy-style fans love, but J.Press still makes them.
Its flap-pocket Oxford is a shirt that works almost anywhere without looking like you tried too hard.
How to wear it: pale blue goes with nearly everything; tuck it into jeans or wear it under a blazer.

items.headline: BOSS bets on tennis style at the Australian Open
items.caption: BOSS is now the official lifestyle outfitter of the Australian Open.
body: BOSS unveiled its collections as the Official Lifestyle Outfitters of the Australian Open.
Esquire argues that tennis, with its century-old 'tennis whites', has shaped how we dress more than almost any sport.
How to wear it: crisp white knits and pleated trousers give you the court look off the court.

items.headline: An $82,000 watch sold out before anyone saw it
items.caption: Fans of indie watchmaker Biver paid deposits from a text description alone.
body: A new $82,000 Biver watch sold out after a New York boutique described it in a fan group chat.
Buyers wired deposits before even seeing a photo, and it is now sold out until 2029.
GQ says this kind of buying from private group chats is common among fans of indie watchmakers.

items.headline: Orlebar Brown drops two new swim shorts for summer
items.caption: Meet the Boxer and the Jack, from the brand that made swim shorts cut like tailored trousers.
body: Orlebar Brown released two new swim shorts ahead of summer, the Boxer and the Jack.
The brand began in 2007 with swim shorts cut like tailored trousers, with side adjusters and a flat front.
How to wear it: a tailored swim short works from the pool to lunch with a linen shirt on top.

items.headline: Top designers all wore the same uniform this season
items.caption: At Milan and Paris shows, a dozen designers bowed in loose tops, dark belts and faded jeans.
body: After the Spring/Summer 2027 shows in Milan and Paris, more than a dozen designers took their bows in nearly the same outfit.
That meant a loose top half-tucked with rolled sleeves, often black, plus a dark leather belt and faded straight-ish jeans.
How to wear it: copy it exactly; it is the easiest designer look you will ever pull off.
